message.content: ThaneChambers expresses enthusiasm for the inclusion of stealth mechanics in the game, believing they could significantly enhance the gameplay experience. He believes that stealth boosts would introduce a new layer to the game, allowing players to approach situations in different ways and potentially creating unique and exciting gameplay experiences. ThaneChambers suggests that stealth could offer strategic advantages in cooperative play, as players could plan sneaky maneuvers together, leading to memorable and thrilling moments.
